lin: possible tokenizer mismatch (HF vs runtime). can you dump token ids for the prompt with both tokenizers?
arjun: also keep an eye on kernel fallback logs — if int8 kernel can't cover the sequence length we sometimes fallback to fp16 and memory pattern changes.
maya: sample prompt (one line): "Summarize the following paragraph in 2 sentences: <TEXT>"

maya: token ids (runtime): [101, 234, 78, 78, 102]
HF token ids: [101, 234, 78, 102] — HF removes duplicate 78. so runtime is inserting a duplicate BOS-ish token.
lin: that suggests a BOS handling bug in our tokenizer wrapper. file a quick repro and run `python -c "print(tokenizer.encode(text).ids)"` against the same HF model checkpoint.
maya: repro snippet I ran:
```
from runtime_tokenizer import Tokenizer
t = Tokenizer('halite-3b')
print(t.encode('Summarize...').ids)
```
gets the dup.
